issues.description: Constructor signature mismatch for GroverTwoQubitWithoutAuxiliaryQubit: the template class defines __init__(self, num_qubits: int) (expecting a parameter) while the solution implements __init__(self) (no parameter) and the problem text / run examples instantiate the class without arguments. This inconsistency is structural and will confuse students about how to construct the class and run the provided examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template constructor signature consistent with the solution and problem examples. Change the template __init__ to have no parameter (def __init__(self):) and initialize number_of_qubits_query_register = 2 as in the solution, or alternatively update the solution and problem text to require and document a num_qubits parameter. Prefer changing the template to def __init__(self): to match the exercise wording and the solution.
